YouControl aggregates 130+ UA registers incl. PSP ownership, but core dossier/API access is paid and requires registration.
Opendatabot is a live register-change API/monitor for the financial population; API key/subscription must be cleared first.
Clarity Project is a live cross-register/procurement analytics portal exposing bank and PSP contract relationships indirectly.
NABU is a first-order banking association and consultation counterparty; standalone site, but fetch failed — recheck liveness.
NABU outgoing-letters archive is a distinct, continuously-producing consultation-submission feed worth monitoring in its own right; fetch failed.
Weekly NABU regulatory-change digest with enumerable numbered archive — exactly the deadline early-warning artefact; verify reachability.
AML committee landing page is a section of nabu.ua already covered by monitoring the parent site and its digest.
EMA legislative dossiers track draft laws and NBU resolutions longitudinally for payments — verified, high-value deadline source.
EMA payment-market news digest is a recurring, verified feed of payments regulatory developments for members.
EMA member roster maps the UA payments ecosystem (banks, PSPs, processors) — mine once for leads, then archive.
AntiFraud HUB/Security Forum programme pages sit under ema.com.ua already monitored via its news and law sections.
AUB is the oldest UA banking association and an active commenter on draft banking legislation; live standalone site.
AUB English press centre is a dated, verified feed summarising NBU regulatory changes — cheap deadline extraction.
AUB analytics is a section of aub.org.ua captured by monitoring the site and its English press feed.
AUB member list and statutes are a one-off enumeration of the represented bank universe.
Single news item on the transparency memorandum — valuable evidence of self-regulatory deadlines, not a recurring feed; URL failed.
UKBS is a named credit-banking association taking regulatory positions, but site unreachable — recheck; ligazakon covers it meanwhile.
VAFK covers non-bank financial/payment companies with dated 'what changes from' explainers and a legislation taxonomy — in scope at equal weight.
IT Ukraine FinTech committee page is a sub-section with thin regulatory output; marginal added signal over the associations already kept.
LinkedIn company profile: entity-resolution value only, low signal and scraping restricted.
Open Banking Ukraine portal publishes API specs and implementation timelines flowing from the NBU/OAG process — payments-core.
Wikipedia pages resolve the NABU naming ambiguity and association aliases once; not a signal producer.
PwC Ukraine tax & legal alert series bundles per-period NBU changes with effective dates in English — strong deadline cross-check (monitor the series index).
Single USUBC article mirroring an NBU open-banking draft notice; useful evidence, weak as a standalone monitored feed.
LIGA:ZAKON/JurLiga reports association objections to draft acts and hosts consolidated law texts — key fallback where association sites are down.
Static fintech catalogue PDF — mine once for the non-bank payments company universe, then archive.
PrivatBank press archive is often the first observable implementation signal (limit/tariff changes with effective dates) of NBU rules.
